about_the_game:
Set of The Legend of Heroes: Kai no Kiseki -Farewell, O Zemuria- DLC items, including consumable items and Zemuria BGM Collection.

- Consumable Item: Handy Helper Set
- Advanced Player Set A
- Advanced Player Set B
- Zemuria BGM Collection
----------
Play the selcted tracks in the Grim Garten.
Sophisticated Fight
The Legend of VII
Knights of Asteria
The Silver Will -Gin no Ishi-
A Light Illuminating The Depths
Atrocious Raid
Overdosing Heavenly Bliss
Miss You
Nostalgic Journey
*Open [DLC] under the [Item] page in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After unlocking items, you can change the BGM via [Epstein Workshop] -> [BGM Change Service] menu within the Grim Garten.
----------

This product is a DLC set for those who have purchased the Standard Edition or the Digital Deluxe Edition. A Digital Ultimate Edition is also available. Beware of duplicate purchases.
